Container.Name: Lyceum
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, Udemy-style player for video courses you own. Progress tracking, notes and bookmarks, transcripts and search (Whisper, on your server), AI study tools, multiple users and libraries, offline downloads.
Container.Requires: Optional: add --device=/dev/dri to Extra Parameters for Intel/AMD hardware video conversion.

Config.Name: Courses
Config.Description: Folder with one sub-folder per course. Change to rw if admins should be able to edit course details (course.json) from the UI.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, sign-in keys, thumbnails, transcripts, converted videos and speech models.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for daily stats and streaks, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when using SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik… (remember to enable WebSocket support).

Config.Name: Initial admin user
Config.Description: Optional: create the first admin automatically instead of using the setup page.

Config.Name: Initial admin password
Config.Description: Optional, used together with the initial admin user.

Config.Name: SSO authority
Config.Description: Optional OpenID Connect issuer URL (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak…).

Config.Name: SSO admin group
Config.Description: Members of this group become Lyceum admins.
